review_method: Task 17 set-level review of six accepted_locked saved-Git assets and their acceptance/review receipts; no image was generated or modified.

set_review.assessment: Six distinct professional textbook/editorial mechanisms: streaming loop, radial TEE privacy architecture, delivery curriculum, mirrored governed gateway, reusable skill hub, and forensic accountability trace.

images.composition: Horizontal streaming-transcription signal laboratory with a latency inset and response loop
images.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram showing live audio entering MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, progressive partial transcript tokens, a 100 ms latency clock, and a return loop from a voice agent response.

images.composition: Radial federated-learning privacy architecture around a central TEE chamber
images.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram showing separate local-data silos sending encrypted updates into a TEE-secured aggregation chamber with remote attestation and approved code, returning only a privacy-preserving global model.

images.composition: Layered enterprise-delivery curriculum converging into a launch gate
images.alt: Textbook delivery blueprint showing business goal, model capability, risk, evaluation, and change management converging through delivery practice toward a governed launch gate associated with Frontier Academy.

images.composition: Mirrored two-sided software-agent exchange through a governed gateway
images.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram showing a customer software agent and an enterprise software agent meeting at a Personal Agent Gateway that verifies identity, consent, and policy before returning a traceable resolution and audit trail.

images.composition: Central versioned Agent Skill cartridge branching into four workflow lanes
images.alt: Textbook mechanism diagram showing one versioned Agent Skill package containing instructions, references, and scripts, installed once and reused across four Copilot workflow lanes with a centralized maintenance loop.

images.composition: Forensic incident cross-section crossing a legal boundary into accountability mapping
images.alt: Textbook forensic accountability diagram tracing a delegated task through an agent action log into a protected system, then through evidence preservation and legal review to deployer, operator, and provider accountability.
